headline: Anthropic Files for Nasdaq IPO in Potential $1.5 Trillion Float
summary: AI startup Anthropic has filed for an initial public offering on the Nasdaq, targeting a potential $1.5 trillion valuation despite reporting a $114 billion loss in the first half of 2026.
why: Anthropic is a major developer of advanced artificial intelligence models, such as Claude, competing directly with OpenAI and Google in the generative AI sector.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: A massive public offering by a leading AI company highlights intense investor interest and high valuations in the artificial intelligence sector.

why_moved: An initial public offering of this magnitude for a prominent AI leader draws substantial investor capital and sets a new valuation benchmark for the entire technology sector.
